description: This file defines a repository interface for LoanTransaction entities using Spring Data JPA. It includes multiple query methods for retrieving, aggregating, and checking loan transactions based on various criteria such as transaction types, dates, reversal status, and relationships. The methods facilitate complex data access patterns required for loan management operations within the Fineract system.

classes.name: LoanTransactionRepository
classes.description: Spring Data JPA repository interface for LoanTransaction entity, providing various methods for data retrieval and aggregation related to loan transactions.

methods.name: findByIdAndLoanId
methods.description: Finds a loan transaction by its ID and associated loan ID.

methods.name: fetchLoanTransactionsByTypeAndLessOrEqualDate
methods.description: Fetches delinquency data for loans based on transaction type and business date.

methods.name: findIdByExternalId
methods.description: Finds the internal ID of a loan transaction by external ID.

methods.name: fetchTotalUnpaidChargesForLoan
methods.description: Retrieves a list of unpaid charge data associated with a specific loan.

methods.name: findLoanIdById
methods.description: Gets the loan ID associated with a specific transaction ID.

methods.name: findTotalUnrecognizedIncomeFromInterestWaiverByLoanAndDate
methods.description: Calculates total unrecognized income from interest waivers for a loan up to a given date.

methods.name: findTotalInterestAccruedAmount
methods.description: Calculates total interest accrued for a loan.

methods.name: findAccrualInterestInPeriod
methods.description: Calculates the interest accrued within a specific period for a loan.

methods.name: isChronologicallyLatest
methods.description: Checks if a transaction date is the latest chronologically for a given loan.

methods.name: findLastTransactionDateForReprocessing
methods.description: Finds the last transaction date suitable for reprocessing, excluding certain transaction types.

methods.name: findTransactionIdsByLoan
methods.description: Returns list of transaction IDs associated with a loan.

methods.name: findReversedTransactionIdsByLoan
methods.description: Returns list of reversed transaction IDs for a loan.

methods.name: findTransactionDataForForeclosureIncome
methods.description: Retrieves transaction portions data relevant for foreclosure income for a loan.

methods.name: findNonReversedByLoanAndTypesAndDate
methods.description: Finds non-reversed transactions by loan, types, and specific date.

methods.name: findNonReversedByLoanAndTypesAndAfterDate
methods.description: Finds transactions after a specific date, filtered by loan and transaction types.

methods.name: findNonReversedByLoanAndTypeAndAfterDate
methods.description: Finds transactions after a date for a specific loan and transaction type.

methods.name: existsNonReversedByLoanAndTypesAndOnOrAfterDate
methods.description: Checks existence of non-reversed transactions on or after a date for a loan and transaction types.

methods.name: findNonReversedByLoanAndTypesAndNotInIds
methods.description: Finds transactions not in a given list of IDs for a loan and transaction types.

methods.name: findNonReversedByLoanAndTypes
methods.description: Finds all non-reversed transactions for a loan filtered by transaction types.

methods.name: findNonReversedByLoanAndType
methods.description: Finds all non-reversed transactions for a loan with a specific transaction type.

methods.name: findNonReversedByLoanAndTypesAndOnOrAfterDate
methods.description: Finds non-reversed transactions on or after a specified date for a loan and transaction types.

methods.name: findCumulativeIncomeByLoanAndType
methods.description: Retrieves cumulative income posting details for a loan.

methods.name: findChargeAccrualAmount
methods.description: Calculates accrued amount for a specific charge.

methods.name: findChargeAccrualAmountByInstallment
methods.description: Calculates accrued amount for a charge in a specific installment.

methods.name: findChargeUnrecognizedWaivedAmount
methods.description: Calculates total unrecognized waived amount for a charge up to a date.

methods.name: findLastNonReversedTransactionDateByLoanAndTypes
methods.description: Finds the latest date of a non-reversed transaction for a loan filtered by types.

methods.name: findNonReversedLoanAndTypeAndDates
methods.description: Finds non-reversed transactions matching specific types and dates.

methods.name: findNonReversedLoanAndTypeAndDate
methods.description: Finds a non-reversed transaction for a loan by type and date.

methods.name: findNonReversedByLoanAndType
methods.description: Retrieve recent non-reversed transactions of a specific type for a loan, with pagination.

methods.name: getAmortizedAmountCapitalizedIncome
methods.description: Calculates total amortized capitalized income for a loan.

methods.name: getAmortizedAmountBuyDownFee
methods.description: Calculates total amortized buy-down fees for a loan.

methods.name: findAdjustments
methods.description: Finds adjustment transactions related to a given transaction.

methods.name: findNonReversedTransactionsForReprocessing
methods.description: Retrieves non-reversed transactions eligible for reprocessing for a loan.

methods.name: calculateTotalRecoveryPaymentAmount
methods.description: Calculates total recovery repayment amount for a loan.

methods.name: existsNonReversedByLoanAndTypeAndAfterDate
methods.description: Checks for existence of non-reversed transactions of a specific type after a date for a loan.

methods.name: fetchClassificationCodeValueByTransactionId
methods.description: Fetches classification code value for a transaction by its ID.
